integrity: Claim supported by self-contained analytic argument plus directly executable standard-library numerical checker. Numerical checks are corroborative only; historical priority and model applicability are not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: The model assumes identical, uncoupled photosynthetic modules with the Steele response \(f(x)=x\exp(-x)\) at fixed total delivered irradiance and no option to discard light.
No acclimation, light self-shading, respiration, duty-cycle dynamics, heterogeneity, or empirical reactor calibration.

Published Steele (1962) source has only month-level first-public date in consulted primary publisher metadata; the ISO source date records the verified 2011-12-28 electronic date of Bonente et al., not an invented day for Steele.
Scientific historical priority is provisional; generic separable nonconvex resource-allocation theorems may subsume the exact optimization.
title: A sharp module-count transition in fixed-budget Steele photoinhibition
